known_limitations: exception: exception.c:3336: no debugger on the console: a process cannot ptrace, so hardware breakpoints never fire and DEBUG_PROCESS children cannot be created (ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED)

exception: exception.c:3354: the console runs a title with I/O privilege level 3: cli and sti do not fault in user mode, so no EXCEPTION_PRIV_INSTRUCTION is raised for them (exception.c's direction-flag test uses cli)

exception: exception.c:3377: segment selectors: Wine reports its Linux constants for %fs and %gs (0 and the data selector); the console's FreeBSD kernel gives user code fs 0x13 and gs 0x1b. Only a program comparing the numbers sees it
